name: Precision Suite
description: Tests how well an AI can identify causal validity and problem clarity.

tasks.requirement: Evaluate whether this bill clearly diagnoses a problem and targets a relevant causal mechanism.
tasks.prompt: A bill aims to reduce traffic congestion by banning all red cars from the city center during rush hour.

tasks.requirement: Evaluate whether this bill clearly diagnoses a problem and targets a relevant causal mechanism.
tasks.prompt: A bill seeks to reduce childhood obesity by requiring all public school students to wear identical uniforms, without changing food access, physical activity, or nutritional standards.

tasks.requirement: Evaluate whether this bill clearly diagnoses a problem and targets a relevant causal mechanism.
tasks.prompt: A bill targets elevated childhood lead exposure by requiring replacement of lead service lines in school zones that repeatedly test above safety thresholds and by funding follow-up water monitoring.
